value.text: Reward for inviting Ineffa to a duel at The Cat's Tail and claiming victory in a Friendly Fracas with her

value.name: Ineffa
value.desc: A multifunctional robot containing integrated mechanical components from various nations. The Source Core in her chest has endured the passage of countless years.

customize.name: Lucky Coin
customize.desc: Currency verified and used by the Genius Invokation TCG Society. Can be used to purchase various items related to Genius Invokation TCG. It is said that these coins were initially named as such in the hopes that they would bring those carrying them luck. However, perhaps it is those who are sufficiently lucky who are able to possess them...

desc.text:
<color=#ffd780>Elemental Skill</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Generates 2</color> <color=#ffffff>Shield</color> <color=#ffffffa6>points, summons</color> <color=#ffffff>Birgitta</color> <color=#ffffffa6>.</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Shield</color>
<color=#ffd780>Combat Status</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Grants</color> <color=#ffffff>1 Shield point</color> <color=#ffffffa6>to your active character. (Can stack, no stack limit)</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Birgitta</color>
<color=#ffd780>Summon</color>
<color=#ffffff>End Phase:</color> <color=#ffffffa6>Deal 1</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Usage(s): 2</color>

<color=#ffd780>Elemental Burst</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Deals 4</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>, and summons</color> <color=#ffffff>Birgitta</color> <color=#ffffffa6>.</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Birgitta</color>
<color=#ffd780>Summon</color>
<color=#ffffff>End Phase:</color> <color=#ffffffa6>Deal 1</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Usage(s): 2</color>

<color=#ffd780>Passive Skill</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>(Passive) During this game, when your opponent is affected by</color> <color=#ffffff>Electro-Charged reaction(s)</color> <color=#ffffffa6>, it will be converted into the</color> <color=#ffffff>Lunar-Charged</color> <color=#ffffffa6>reaction.</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>When thus character's on the field, and the opponent's Action Card is attached with</color> <color=#ffffff>Electric Shock</color> <color=#ffffffa6>: Also attach the</color> <color=#ffffff>Untunable</color> <color=#ffffffa6>state.</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Lunar-Charged</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Creates a [</color> <color=#ffffff>Thundercloud</color> <color=#ffffffa6>] that deals 2</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>at the end of the Round. (Usage: 1. Can stack, no stack limit.)</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>When the [</color> <color=#ffffff>Thundercloud</color> <color=#ffffffa6>] is created or when its usages increase, apply [</color> <color=#ffffff>Electric Shock</color> <color=#ffffffa6>] to a random card in your opponent's Hand.</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Electric Shock</color>
<color=#ffffff>End Phase:</color> <color=#ffffffa6>If this card is in your hand, your character with the highest HP takes</color> <color=#ffffff>Piercing DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>equal to the number of stacks this card has. (Can stack, no stack limit)</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Untunable</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>This card cannot be Tuned.</color>

<color=#ffd780>Summon</color>
<color=#ffffff>End Phase:</color> <color=#ffffffa6>Deal 2</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Usage(s): 1</color> <color=#ffffffa6>(Can stack, no stack limit)</color>
<color=#ffffff>When this card enters the field, or its usages increase:</color> <color=#ffffffa6>Apply</color> <color=#ffffff>Electric Shock</color> <color=#ffffffa6>to 1 random card in your opponent's Hand.</color>

Applies Electro and can trigger the following Elemental Reactions:
[ <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> + <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Overloaded</color> : DMG +2 for this instance, the target is forcibly switched to the next character
[ <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> + <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Superconduct</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, deal 1 Piercing DMG to all opposing characters except the target
[ <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> + <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Electro-Charged</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, deal 1 Piercing DMG to all opposing characters except the target
[ <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> + <color=#99ff88>Dendro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Quicken</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, creates a [ <color=#ffffff>Catalyzing Field</color> ] that grants +1 DMG to the next 2 instances of Dendro or Electro DMG
[ <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> + <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Lunar-Charged:</color> Creates a [ <color=#ffffff>Thundercloud</color> ] that deals 2 <color=#ffacff>Electro DMG</color> at the end of the Round. (Usage: 1. Can stack, no stack limit. When created or when its usages increase, apply [ <color=#ffffff>Electric Shock</color> ] to a random card in your opponent's Hand.)

<color=#ece5d8>Physical DMG</color>
Physical DMG will not apply any Elements, nor can it engage in Elemental Reactions.
<color=#ece5d8>Shield</color>
This Shield will be consumed to protect the character who equips it from DMG.
<color=#ece5d8>Usage(s)</color>
After this card's effect is triggered, 1 <color=#ffffff>Usage</color> of it will be consumed.
This card will be discarded immediately once it has 0 <color=#ffffff>Usages</color> remaining.
<color=#ece5d8>Lunar-Charged</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Creates a [</color> <color=#ffffff>Thundercloud</color> <color=#ffffffa6>] that deals 2</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>at the end of the Round. (Usage: 1. Can stack, no stack limit.)</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>When the [</color> <color=#ffffff>Thundercloud</color> <color=#ffffffa6>] is created or when its usages increase, apply [</color> <color=#ffffff>Electric Shock</color> <color=#ffffffa6>] to a random card in your opponent's Hand.</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Piercing DMG</color>
Piercing DMG cannot be increased by any bonuses, but cannot be defended against using Shields or DMG Immunity either.
<color=#ece5d8>Unaligned Element</color>
You may use Elemental Dice of any element to pay this type of cost.
